主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced that Director Rene Joyce plans to resign from the Board of Directors effective at the 2013 annual shareholder meeting, a year earlier than originally scheduled, due to other business commitments. This resignation follows the Board's approval of a succession plan in March 2011, which outlined the retirement of Joe Perna in 2013 and Rene Joyce in 2014. The Board may need to nominate two replacement candidates for the 2013 annual meeting, as directors may only serve three-year terms. The Nominating and Governance Committee has already identified two candidates for these positions, which will be formally recommended at the Board's February 2013 meeting. There are no disputes between the Company and Mr. Joyce. The resignation is effective at the 2013 annual meeting, and the Board will proceed with the necessary nominations to ensure continuity in leadership.
